name: Insurance claim repairs
summary: Storm, collision, fire or water damage: we inspect it, write the estimate for your insurer and do the repair.
includes: An estimate with photos and a parts list for your insurer
bring: Your insurance company’s name and your claim number, if you have one
Your adjuster’s name and phone number, if you have one
Photos of the damage taken when it happened

faq.q: Do I call my insurer first, or you?
faq.a: Call your insurer to open the claim, then call us to book the inspection.
faq.confirm: Insurance claim steps: who calls the insurer first?

faq.q: Which insurance companies do you work with?
faq.a: Call us and tell us who your insurer is.
faq.confirm: Which insurers does VOW work with often? (The old site says "all major insurance companies", unverified.)

faq.q: How do I pay the deductible?
faq.a: You pay the deductible to us when you pick up the RV.
faq.confirm: How is the deductible paid, and when?
